_comment: date_order MDY because the sheet locale is en_US (get_values returns M/D/YYYY for real date cells). Maps sheet 'Category' values (case-insensitive) to a class. Edit after the questionnaire. Classes: goal = moves the roadmap; income = paid work; maintenance = body/admin; rest = deliberate recovery; drift = unintended time loss. 'Sleep' is excluded from time-allocation shares.
